buyer.step1Desc: Start by setting up a new shipment, specifying the supplier, logistics provider, arbiter, and milestone percentage splits.
buyer.step2Desc: Funds are securely deposited and locked into the Stellar Soroban escrow contract until milestones are satisfied.
buyer.step3Desc: Review submitted proofs from your counterparties and confirm milestones to release funds automatically.

supplier.step1Desc: Track all shipments where you are designated as the supplier and verify agreed payment milestone splits.
supplier.step2Desc: Upload cryptographic proof hashes for finished milestones to notify the buyer and trigger confirmation.
supplier.step3Desc: Once confirmed, escrowed USDC is directly disbursed to your Stellar address without intermediaries.

logistics.step1Desc: Monitor in-transit cargo where your wallet is designated as the trusted logistics verification partner.
logistics.step2Desc: Verify physical cargo handoffs and submit proof of transit checkpoints on-chain.
logistics.step3Desc: Your verified checkpoints ensure transparency between buyer and supplier throughout transport.

arbiter.step1Desc: Review contested shipments and milestones requiring neutral third-party arbiter adjudication.
arbiter.step2Desc: Inspect submitted delivery proofs, milestone timelines, and dispute rationales from both parties.
arbiter.step3Desc: Execute definitive on-chain dispute resolutions to release funds to the supplier or refund the buyer.
